summary: Ctrl+L triages outstanding Inbox items in the focused split: questions and requests first, then decisions, then failures, then other items. Within each class, oldest requested timestamp comes first; unknown timestamps follow known ones, with item ID breaking ties. Backward traversal and all-clear wrap feedback are available.

compatibility.detail: Ctrl+L remains program input while attached. Leader l traverses backward everywhere; enhanced Ctrl+Shift+L is the detached alias.
